meta.name: user-segmentation
meta.description: Segment users from feedback data based on behavior, JTBD, and needs. Identifies at least 3 distinct user segments. Use when segmenting a user base, analyzing diverse user feedback, or building a segmentation model.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 根据反馈数据自动划分用户群体
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果手头有大量用户反馈需要按行为或需求分组
copy.tagline_en: Segment users automatically from feedback data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have user feedback to group by behavior or needs

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会分析你提供的用户反馈数据，识别出至少3个不同的用户群体，并描述每个群体的行为、动机和需求。
howto.when: 当你需要细分用户群体、分析多样化的用户反馈，或构建用户分群模型时触发。

say.text: 帮我根据这些用户反馈数据做用户分群。
say.note: Claude 会分析数据并输出至少3个用户群体。

say.text: 分析这些客服工单，找出不同的用户类型。
say.note: Claude 会从工单中提取行为模式并分组。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will analyze your user feedback data and identify at least 3 distinct user segments, describing each segment's behavior, motivations, and needs.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to segment a user base, analyze diverse user feedback, or build a segmentation model.

say_en.text: Segment these user feedback data for me.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze and output at least 3 segments.

say_en.text: Analyze these support tickets to find different user types.
say_en.note: Claude will extract behavior patterns and group them.
